presets.name: Dash Pro Default
presets.author: Lovely Sim Racing
presets.description: The pages and layouts Lovely Dashboard Pro comes with: tyres, TC and ABS on the main page, full screen standings, damage and track map, and a qualifying page with delta, estimated lap and average tyre temperatures.

presets.name: Hypercar Endurance LMU
presets.author: George Margetis-HVT
presets.description: Made for Hypercar endurance races in Le Mans Ultimate, with everything Team Hellas Vision Racing uses in long races: a main page for practice and the race, a qualifying page and a full screen track map. No extra plugins needed.

presets.name: Hypercar Endurance LMU JRG
presets.author: JRG Racing
presets.description: For LMU Hypercars, on two pages used in every session, with no separate qualifying page: the main page has TC, the class gaps and the tyres on the left, regen, SoC, brake bias and migration on the right, and fuel, VE and pit loss along the bottom; the second page swaps in a large multifunction panel on the left (tyres) and the car's settings on the right.

presets.name: iRacing TCR Dash
presets.author: Chris Indeherberge
presets.description: For iRacing's TCR class, with a page for each session that follows your own class in multiclass races. Practice and qualifying are about lap times, with the last lap, the session best and the delta (and the class best in qualifying), plus fuel use; the race page has the gaps to the class cars ahead and behind, fuel use, the pit window and pit loss. RPM and speed in the centre, brake bias and ABS at the bottom right.

presets.name: LMU GT3
presets.author: Clive Melbourne
presets.description: For GT3 in Le Mans Ultimate, with separate race and qualifying layouts: a detailed Primary page for practice and the race, and a lighter Qualifying page focused on the hotlap. No top bar or sidebars.

presets.name: LMU Hyper
presets.author: Rontti
presets.description: For Hypercar in Le Mans Ultimate, with a Primary page for practice and the race, with track gaps on top and the fuel, VE and battery sidebars, and a Quali page with the delta along the top and in a large module next to the estimated lap time.

presets.name: Lovely Dashboard Classic
presets.author: Lovely Sim Racing
presets.description: The original Lovely Dashboard, reincarnated in Lovely Dashboard Pro.

presets.name: Lovely Dashboard Companion
presets.author: Lovely Sim Racing
presets.description: The Lovely Dashboard Companion in Lovely Dashboard Pro: full screen map, track opponents, standings, relative, radar, telemetry, tyres and damage.

presets.name: Lovely Flags
presets.author: Lovely Sim Racing
presets.description: The Lovely Flags dashboard in Lovely Dashboard Pro: one full screen page with the flags.

presets.name: Rallye Dash
presets.author: Lovely Sim Racing
presets.description: A rally dash: one main page with gear, speed, RPM, session and lap time, the four tyres and the engine's temperatures and pressures, plus a full screen zoomed-in track map, damage and standings. Both sidebars are Virtual RPM shift lights.

presets.name: Simple GT3
presets.author: JRG Racing
presets.description: A simple GT3 layout for Le Mans Ultimate. The Primary page for practice and the race has large tire modules on the left and fuel, VE and the pit stop on the right. The Quali page shows lap times, time remaining and tire temperatures, and a full screen Damage page completes the set.

presets.name: Thaus0n iRacing
presets.author: Thaus0n
presets.description: For iRacing, with one layout for every session: TC, ABS and brake bias on the left, the delta and lap times on the right, fuel along the bottom and the PC clock in the centre, plus a full screen leaderboard for practice and the race.
